method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 叙述者说有时能从岸边看到他们
facts.anchor: You can see them sometimes from shore.

facts.fact: 这家人不知从哪儿弄到一条小帆船，可能是便宜货因为已显破旧
facts.anchor: A family who got a small sailboat somewhere, probably at a bargain because it’s seen better days.

facts.fact: 船上常是一位头发花白、明显跛行的老妇人（暗指 Hattie）
facts.anchor: usually it’s an older woman with graying hair and a pronounced limp

facts.fact: 还有一个瘦削年轻男子（可能是她儿子）和一个与两人都极像的少年
facts.anchor: a slim younger man—probably her son—along with a teenage boy who bears a striking resemblance to them both.

facts.fact: 他们在海湾里来回航行，有时驶向更远的外海
facts.anchor: They sail the bay back and forth and sometimes venture farther out to open water

facts.fact: 但他们总能找到回来的路
facts.anchor: But they always find their way back.
